notes.title: Update on request
notes.content:
Hello everyone!ːsteamhappyː
Here is a small update that you requested from me
Added windowed mode (to switch enter the game and switch it in the settings)
Added keyboard support for two players. Just press any button on your keyboard instead of a gamepad.
